name: Tragic Banshee — the "-13/-13 instead" rider is not stacked on the -1/-1
notes: Memory: project_audit_small_clusters_round_eight_2026-10-11. Once a clause before a target phrase was dropped from filters, "If a creature died this turn, target creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead" became a second targeted effect in its own slot. Such a rider in a fired ability is left out, as Tragic Slip's is for a spell.
